campaigns.title: NVIDIA · Back to school
campaigns.subtitle: Creator-led science & engineering projects
campaigns.brief: NeoReach describes a campaign promoting GeForce RTX 30 Series laptops to American STEM students. Creators showed science and engineering projects using the laptops. The public case page includes selected content and names creators; it does not disclose individual contracts or campaign deadlines.
campaigns.question: Which public videos can we verify for this campaign, and what needs a human follow-up?
campaigns.ui_summary: NVIDIA wanted to reach STEM students. NeoReach worked with creators who demonstrated science and engineering projects on GeForce RTX laptops.

campaigns.title: NVIDIA · Shield launch
campaigns.subtitle: Tech reviews, gaming & launch content
campaigns.brief: NeoReach describes a Shield launch campaign with technology and gaming creators, Twitch streams, reviews and giveaways. Its public case page embeds selected YouTube content. A video embedded on the page may be posted by a creator or the NVIDIA brand channel; it is not proof of a paid contract.
campaigns.question: Who published the videos in this campaign? Separate the brand channel from other publishers and explain what we can verify.
campaigns.ui_summary: NeoReach brought together tech reviews, gaming streams and giveaways for the NVIDIA Shield launch. The public case page links to selected videos.
